title: SendPrepState job names a media-prep send, but its worker task is detached and the job is a bare u64
trigger: Tap Send on a tray with a video; the prep worker or its continuation never completes (worker panic or dropped executor task)
effect: The slot stays 'preparing': every later Send in that chat is refused with 'Preparing the files' and the tray shows the spinner until restart or logout (cancel_account is the only other exit)
fix: enum PrepStage { Preparing { _task: Task<()> } } held per SendSlot in ComposerSends, so dropping the slot or the task ends the stage

title: begin_media_prep detaches the continuation (spawn_scoped_in(..).detach()) instead of the stage holding it
trigger: Account removed or app exits while the worker runs
effect: Continuation runs (or not) independent of the job list; finish_media_prep must find the job by number to know it was cancelled
fix: hold the Task in the PrepJob stage

title: build_passkeys_dialog resets the delete confirmation (dismiss_confirm) from inside the dialog's render builder
trigger: Delete a passkey from another device while the confirm box is up; the list dialog render clears PasskeysScreen::ConfirmDelete
effect: A stage is left by render instead of by its own transition; passkey_confirm() already hides it, so two readers each decide when the confirm is over
fix: drop the reset in render; let the answer that removes the passkey call dismiss_confirm, and keep passkey_confirm() as the only reader

title: sync_twofa_forms empties the 2FA inputs every frame from a session flag; the box stage (TwoStepUi) and the session TwofaFlow move together by hand
trigger: Finish a recovery or login-email step; next frame the form inputs are cleared by the frame upkeep, not by the transition that finished the step
effect: Inputs, TwoFaBox and TwofaFlow are three owners kept in step by twofa_open/goto/step_done plus a per-frame fix-up; a path that bypasses goto_twofa_view leaves stale text
fix: let TwoFaBox::Open carry the input values' lifetime (clear them in the same transition that sets notice), and drop the per-frame sync

title: Sticker flight state is five process-wide thread_locals (SOURCE, FLIGHT, TARGET, ORIGIN, CELLS) kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick a sticker in the panel (note_source) and have the send neither armed nor refused (e.g. send path returns early)
effect: SOURCE survives until the next note_source/end_flight, so a later send of the same sticker file can fly from a stale cell; state is process-global, not per window or account (only end_flight on screen leave/lock clears it)
fix: one Flight value in the WindowSlot: Idle | Picked{source} | Waiting | Flying, cleared by its owner's Farewell

title: Two sources for the page: settings.nav.page() and settings_page_shown() diverge when Agent access is turned off under its page
trigger: On the Agent access page, Revoke the last agent / turn access off (turn_agent_access_off, not set_agent_access)
effect: The window draws Advanced while nav still says AgentAccess: leave_settings_page(AgentAccess) does not run until the user leaves, and the sidebar/search treat the page as current only through the fallback
fix: turn_agent_access_off should move nav to Advanced itself (show_settings_page), so there is one page value

title: TrayReads keeps six u64 job counters beside Read::Reading{job}; a stale answer is told from the current one by number
trigger: Remove and re-add a tray file while its read runs
effect: Counters stand in for request identity; they work because Reads::start replaces the stage and holds the tasks, but each reader must compare the number by hand
fix: let Read::Reading own its tasks and drop the job number: an answer addresses the stage by holding a handle (Weak/Task id) instead of a counter

title: known leftover: PreferencesUi::update_recheck is a bare Option<Task> release-recheck timer (arm_update_recheck, allow-listed in owned-timers-allow.txt)
trigger: Updates page open or app idle
effect: Timer lives beside UpdateState rather than in a stage of it; runs while hidden/locked per the allow-list
fix: UpdateState::Idle { next_check: Task } so the timer is part of the stage

title: Settings box open flags for masks/emoji sets live in the Session (stickers.masks.dialog_open, stickers.emoji.open) and are closed by SettingsUi::farewell by hand
trigger: Open Emoji sets or Masks box from Settings, switch account
effect: Each box needs a hand-written closer in Farewell; a new session-owned box flag is missed until someone adds it (the farewell comment lists the business sticker pick as an example)
fix: move the open state into SettingsBox (UI-owned) so the OnScreen swap drops it

title: ScreenShareUi.demo_active (Option<DemoShare>) and demo_system_audio (bool) are two fields for the demo's share, plus backend: Option<Arc<..>>
effect: Three fields set together by demo_call_screen_share; not a runtime bug
fix: one DemoShare { source, with_audio, backend } Option

title: chat_ui.send_as_open is a bool open flag; the popover only shows it while send_as_list_empty() is false
trigger: Open the send-as menu; TDLib answers an empty list (menu hides, flag stays true); a later refresh returns a non-empty list
effect: The menu pops open on its own because the stored flag outlived the visible state; toggle_send_as recomputes the flag from the list but nothing clears it when the list turns empty
fix: enum SendAsMenu { Closed, Open } cleared by the answer that finds the list empty, or derive open from the fetch stage

title: Search/chat-search commits are matched by a bare u64 token (SearchQueryOutcome::Debounced{token}, ChatSearchQueryOutcome::Debounced{token}) while the timer Task is held in SearchUi::debounce
trigger: Type quickly in global or chat search
effect: Counter stands in for the pending commit; works because the driver checks it, but the Debounce struct holds Task::ready(()) as its idle value instead of an Option/stage
fix: enum Debounce { Idle, Waiting { token, _timer: Task<()> } } so the stage owns the timer and the token
